chapter: Famous Door, the union dispute and Stuff Smith's last years
title: Stuff walks out alone in California; Eddie Barefield fronts; the band all leaves together
summary: When Stuff left for New York the union sent him back; Jones brought in Eddie Barefield, and in the end the band left together, went to Buffalo to pay their way back, and found Kirby's group in the Onyx.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: And then I was pretty happy there anyway, and making about $50.00 a night tips. In the Vendome Hotel. But now we get back here and then we start to act halfway decent. It was mostly Stuff. I say it was mostly Stuff, because he was the one who had signed everything, you know. Once in California, before we left the first time, he left by himself, and you know what we did? We got Eddie Barefield. Yeah, I'm glad we leaned on it awhile, because I remember. Now, he was out there about a month and a half and he said, "Let's go back to New York, you know?" And I said, "No, you've got to put in a notice and you've got to go to and ask the agent about this." They had the representative there in California. So he must have went and they said, "No, you can't do that, Stuff. You've got to stay there." So we come to work one night and Stuff wasn't there, and they told us -- we called the hotel and they told us Stuff left this morning for New York. And I called up Eddie Barefield. So I got in front of the group and the Bear played. He was out there. I forget now how Eddie Barefield was out there, but he was there, and I brought him in there, because he wasn't working, so I brought him in and I got in front of the band. And we played and the guys said, "That's
all right, I hope he stays in New York and we'll keep the band just like this."

But then they sent him back. The union sent him back to California and then he comes back and we started laughing at him because they sent him back, so he tells us now, if we all had left together they couldn't have done it. "But they made me come back because you all stayed. If we all had left together, it couldn't have happened."

Now, Cozy goes for this hook, line and sinker, because he wants to get away, you know. He wants to get away from California too. And he goes and says, "You know, Jonah, he might have something there." I said, "Well, maybe." I said, "I don't know. I don't know." He said, "Do you realize we've got three months and a half more to go out here? They can have all that sunshine." He wanted to get back, because you see, New York was a different place then. You know, it was a lot of fun. So then, okay, not it comes up again. Stuff sat back there and said, "Well, if you all want to go, I'll put in a notice. I'll put in a notice. We can go together. We'll go right back to the Onyx." And that was before we all left.

Then that works up to where we all left together and they made us go to Buffalo and pay our way on back out there and then we come on back. But we didn't go back into the Onyx. We went -- because by this time John
Kirby's cooking in there. Yeah, with Maxine. They don't need us now.
